messages:
support-lead: :rotating_light: Customer reported sustained 502/504s from hosted inference in eu2 (started ~12:05 UTC). Multiple customers calling out timeouts and retry storms. Escalating to incidents channel.

marcus: Seeing a clear spike in 5xxs around 12:04-12:10 UTC. API gateway shows increased downstream timeouts to runtime pools in eu2-az3. Error samples: `upstream error` / `connection reset by peer`.

nina: Customer repro steps sent: single prompt, 8k tokens, get 502 after ~3-5s on ~10% of attempts. They attached request ids: `req-0a1b2c3d4e`, `req-0f9e8d7c6b`.

eng-sre: Pulling metrics now. 5xx rate for eu2 routes jumped from 0.4% -> 18% at 12:03. P50 latency stable, P95 spikes and tails. Backend connection errors and TCP retransmit counters are up on instance NICs.

networking: I see elevated retransmits and RTOs on the eu2-az3 egress facing provider circuits starting 12:01 UTC. Packet loss ~1-3% on some paths, with bursts. Running traceroute to provider next-hops.

oncall-bot: Incident severity set to P2 by support-lead. Pager sent to oncall (marcus).

ben: Putting short repro script here so SREs can reproduce from our side quickly:
```bash
for i in {1..50}; do 
  curl -s -X POST 
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" 
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
    -d '{"model":"open-7b","input":"test"}' 
    https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/generate || echo "fail $i"; 
done
```

customer-sre: We captured tcpdump from customer side showing retransmits and DUP ACKs, then connection resets to 10.121.77.200:443 (our edge).

networking: Traceroute from a noisy host to our edge IP 35.208.99.12:
````
1  10.0.0.1  0.5 ms
2  192.0.2.5  1.1 ms
3  * * *
4  203.0.113.45  12.7 ms  
5  198.51.100.9  95.4 ms  (transit)
6  35.208.99.12  96.1 ms
````
Hops 3-5 show asymmetric delays and packet loss.

marcus: Provider-side BGP logs show flaps for ASN 64521 peering with eu2 POPs between 12:00-12:06. Opening ticket with provider (FastTransit).

nina: Customer-facing impact: some customers seeing continuous failures for ~6-8 minutes, causing retries and duplicate completions. One customer flagged as SEV by their ops team.

eng-sre: Mitigation plan: 1) enable region fallback for affected routes to eu1 for new requests, 2) increase gateway connection timeout/retry backoff to reduce retry storm, 3) route around affected ALBs in eu2-az3. I can push a canary for 1 in 5 mins.

support-lead: Please hold off on broad failover until we sync on rollback criteria. Ben — run repro against eu1 to validate behavior and verify model parity.

ben: Running tests against eu1 now, reporting back in 3 mins.

networking: Provider ticket opened: FT-2026-4483. They acknowledge packet loss and are investigating a transit aggregation device in FRA. ETA unknown.

eng-sre: Short-term routing tweak applied: removed 2 ALBs behind eu2-az3 autoscaling group from LB rotation for 5 mins. Observed drop in connection reset errors on gateway metrics. P95 latency improving.

marcus: Rolling region-fallback to eu1 for specific high-error client routes (opt-in for now) and adding header `x-fallback-eu1: true` for traceability.

customer-sre: Customer confirms reduction in errors after fallback. They still see occasional timeouts on older inflight requests but overall success rate improved.

networking: Provider says they deployed a partial fix at 12:18 and are monitoring. We should keep ALB rotation change for 10 more minutes then slowly reintroduce.

support-lead: Actions / owners: 
- eng-sre (marcus): monitor error rates, rollback if eu1 shows regressions.
- networking (nina): keep provider ticket open, collect pcap and BGP dump, push for RCA.
- support-lead: notify impacted customers with status update and mitigation steps.
- customer-sre (ben): validate customer repro and collect final logs.

oncall-bot: Pager duty note: incident auto-close won't trigger until manual resolution recorded.

eng-sre: Follow-up notes: we'll add a synthetic to detect short-duration packet-loss-induced 5xx spikes and a runbook step to automatically enable region-fallback for critical clients if >10% 5xx for 3m. Filing follow-up JIRA RDW-1897.

support-lead: Closing thread for now — continuing investigation in provider ticket FT-2026-4483 and JIRA. If anything changes re-open. :white_check_mark:
